# Data Access

The Data Access layer manages per-installation settings in Cloudflare KV.

## Overview

This layer is responsible for storing and retrieving user settings and repository information for each installation of the app. It uses Cloudflare KV to persist data, ensuring that settings and repository lists are available even if the app is restarted.

## Responsibilities

- Store and retrieve user settings for each installation.
- Manage repository lists for each installation.
- Handle the creation and deletion of repository keys.
- Provide methods to update settings and repository lists.

## Key components

| File | Purpose | Main definitions |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [`app/src/settings.ts`](../app/src/settings.ts) | Manages per-installation settings in Cloudflare KV. | `COMMENT_LEVELS`, `CommentLevel`, `EXISTING_CODE`, `ExistingCode`, `Settings`, `Choices` |

## How it works

The Data Access layer uses Cloudflare KV to store settings and repository information. Each installation has a unique prefix in KV, and settings and repository keys are stored under this prefix. The `SettingsStore` class provides methods to interact with these keys, including retrieving settings, adding and removing repositories, and deleting installation data.

## Configuration

This layer does not require any configuration settings, environment variables, or configuration files. It directly interacts with Cloudflare KV using the provided KVNamespace object.
